title: Reader supplements
description: reader-supplements.json in the work folder: evidence the drawing-reader agent adds to a question a PRODUCER raised (`harness ask <work_dir> --supplement Q-id --where W --found F --text T [--file F] [--sheet S]`), instead of asking it again. A supplement never changes the target question: not its blocking flag, not its answer, not its refs. It is shown under the question in questions.md. Identity: `key` = first 16 hex of sha256 over (target key, file, the file's sha256, where); supplementing the same place again prints `already_supplemented`. A supplement whose target question is obsolete in the registry is shown as stale (status computed on read, never stored). `harness ask --withdraw-supplement <key> --reason R` marks one withdrawn (kept). A reader-owned target, an unknown or obsolete target, or --code / --blocking given with --supplement is a usage error (exit 2).

supplements.description: In the order they were added.

key.description: Stable identity of this supplement (see above).

target_key.description: Registry key of the supplemented question.

target_id.description: The target's id when the supplement was added.

target_producer.description: Never 'reader': the reader edits its own questions with ask / withdraw.

file.description: Inventory path the evidence is in; null for project-level evidence.

file_sha256.description: The inventory's sha256 of file when the supplement was added; null when file is null.

sheet.description: Detector sheet id (model#01, <layout>#01); null when none was given.

found.description: Verbatim from the drawing (may be empty).

text.description: The reader's note, in Vietnamese, printed verbatim in questions.md.
